name: The Bee Supply
notes: Full retail store. Also pickup in Round Rock TX. Rated 4.8/5 (190 reviews). Offers beekeeping classes.

name: JC's Honey Bees
notes: $150 deposit required. Pickup first weekend of May. Deposits nonrefundable.

name: Sabine Creek Honey Farm
notes: Hobbyist education focus. PO Box 6, Josephine TX 75164. Call ahead. Rated 4.8/5.

name: Ames Farm
notes: Best value in East TX. F1 VSH hybrids from VP Queens breeder stock. 4 deep frames + queen + feeder in Pro Nuc box. 10-day replacement guarantee. Cancellation refund before March 1.

name: BeeWeaver Honey Farm
notes: Texas' most historic bee operation — since 1888. Treatment-free breeding program. Farm tours available. 668 reviews, 4.8/5 rating.

name: SweetNes Honey Apiaries & Beetique
notes: Lowest price in Texas. 50% deposit required. Family-owned farm and bee rescue. Also offers bee removals, pollination, ag exemptions. Retail shop in Needville.

name: Mann Lake — Conroe TX Pickup
notes: National supplier with local TX pickup. First-order ~10% discount. VSH $195.95, Cordovan $199.95, Russian $225.95.

name: Mann Lake — Marquez TX Pickup
notes: Second TX pickup location for Mann Lake. VSH Cordovan nucs.

name: Lockhart Honey Farms
notes: Best bulk pricing in TX. 5-pack: $200/ea, 10-pack: $175/ea, 25-pack: $175/ea, 50-pack: $150/ea, 100-pack: $125/ea. Commercial operation (2,800+ hives, 5 states). All sales final.

name: Two Hives Honey
notes: Premium option. 5-frame $350, 6-frame $385 (in reusable wooden box). Wall-to-wall bees. Multiple pickup dates. Also runs hive tours. No refunds on nucs.

name: McKane Apiaries
notes: Full-service Austin apiary. Also offers hive management ($115/visit), ag valuation hive leases ($275), and queens ($45).

name: Bee Mindful
notes: Unique: only certified Russian treatment-free top-bar nucs in Central TX. 4-5 drawn comb bars. Compatible only with horizontal top-bar hives. Also offers apprenticeships and workshops.

name: Walker Honey Farm
notes: Pickup at 8060 E US Hwy 190, Rogers TX. Well-reviewed — repeat customers. Staff loads nucs into your vehicle. 3 frames brood, frames of food, marked Italian queen.

name: Ross Creek Organic Farm
notes: $100 deposit, $175 balance at pickup. Cash/Zelle accepted. Organic approach with essential oil health treatments. Bees wintered in East TX.

name: Prime Bees
notes: Pickup in San Marcos, College Station, or professional installation available. 60-day guarantee. Includes online beginner course access. 2025 mated/marked queen.

name: The Bee Place
notes: Early bird $245, standard $295. Includes mite strip and transport tote. Texan bees available from April 11+. Also sells complete hives and runs beekeeping classes.

name: Charlie Bee Company
notes: $150 deposit, balance at pickup. Marked, mated VSH queen from East TX breeder. 1-month spring warranty. Currently sold out — order early.

name: Northeast Texas Beekeepers Association (NETBA)
notes: Key bee club for Van Zandt County area. Members frequently sell nucs to each other. 2nd Monday, 6:30pm at First Baptist Church, Canton. Best resource for local East TX nuc connections.

name: Kaufman Area Beekeepers Association
notes: Active club in high-traffic county for our calculator. 2nd Tuesday, 6:30pm at Kaufman UMC. Good source for local nuc recommendations.

name: Rusk County Beekeepers Association
notes: Henderson County club. 3rd Tuesday, 6:30pm. Same county as Ames Farm.

name: Houston Beekeepers Association
notes: Largest Houston-area club. 3rd Tuesday, 7-8:30pm. Great resource for finding local nuc sellers.

name: Alamo Area Beekeepers Association
notes: Primary San Antonio area bee club. 3rd Tuesday of odd months, 6:30-8:30pm at SA Botanical Gardens.

name: Caprock Beekeepers Association
priceRange: Varies — most order from Central TX
notes: Only TBA-affiliated club in the Panhandle. Limited local nuc production. 3rd Thursday, 6:30-8pm.

name: Permian Basin Beekeeping Association
priceRange: Varies — most source from Central/East TX
notes: 3rd Monday, 6:30pm. Limited local nuc availability in West Texas.
